name: KAISER 5 TOURING

specs.notes: BMW M's M5 Touring (G99): a 4.4 twin-turbo V8 plug-in hybrid, 727 PS and 1,000 N m combined, M xDrive, an eight-speed automatic, ~2,550 kg (40 kg over the saloon), 0-100 km/h in 3.6 s. Its torque curve holds the combined 1,000 N m to ~5,100 rpm, then the 727 PS (535 kW) to 6,500 rpm (BMW's press release: 727 hp and 1,000 N m combined, the V8 to 7,200 rpm); before October 2026 it held 1,000 N m to 5,900 rpm, 840 PS. Its gearbox is BMW's: 5.000 / 3.200 / 2.143 / 1.720 / 1.297 / 1.000 / 0.833 / 0.640 on a 3.308 final drive (BMW's M5 Touring press kit, 08/2024; eighth at ~1,500 rpm at 100 km/h), and its electronic limiter holds 305 km/h (with the M Driver's Package; 250 without); before October 2026 a 5.15 final drive ran it into the rev limiter in eighth at 305 km/h. Its aero is an estimate.

garage.blurb: A family estate with 727 horsepower and a tonne of torque: the heaviest thing on the street and the quickest to the next junction.

interior.notes: The model's own cabin: its steering wheel cut out to turn (tools/cars/m5_touring.json), the eye placed by hand from section views; an automatic or dual clutch: the hands stay on the wheel.
